title: kate-search: skip a replacement that copies the hit
summary: replace_all drops an edit whose old text equals its new text. An empty pattern still returns an empty transaction. A real change still counts. The test goes in the existing replace tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: replace.rs has one test module named tests.  Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Do not add a second module with the same name. Keep pub(crate) on replace_all. After the edit value is built and before edits.push, write one if. if edit.old == edit.new { continue; } Do not put that check inside the if literal block. Do not write if literal { if edit.old == edit.new { ... } }. Do not touch pattern_is_empty, find_all, find_next, keep_disjoint, capture_names, or edits_overlap. The test a_same_replacement_inserts_nothing uses the buffer aba. A plain pattern a replaced by a returns count 0 and an empty transaction. A plain pattern a replaced by b returns count 2. An empty plain pattern replaced by x still returns count 0. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: replace::tests::a_same_replacement_inserts_nothing
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. Replacing a with a in aba returns count 2. After the change the count is 0 and the transaction is empty. Replacing a with b still returns count 2. An empty pattern still returns count 0.
